question: Should ClickClack core ship and maintain this six-format artifact viewer and its new browser parsing dependencies?
rationale: Implementation quality and proof are now strong, but the patch creates a significant new user-facing surface and continuing parser/security ownership that repository history and discussion do not show a maintainer has accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the full viewer
options.body: Accept all six formats and their ongoing dependency and security ownership, then proceed through normal draft and maintainer review.

options.title: Narrow the initial formats
options.body: Keep formats using existing infrastructure and defer DOCX conversion or syntax highlighting to reduce the initial maintained attack surface.

options.title: Retain download-only documents
options.body: Decline the new core viewer boundary and preserve the current attachment and authenticated-download behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full viewer
recommendation.body: Accept all six formats and their ongoing dependency and security ownership, then proceed through normal draft and maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history ties the current attachment component and release baseline directly to his work.
